title: Essentially Essential
description: The modpack with only the most esssential mods!
body:
**Essentially Essential** is a no-nonsense modpack for Fabric and NeoForge 1.21.1 that includes everything you actually want and nothing you don't.

Just pure performance improvements and essential QoL, the stuff that should honestly just be in the base game.

**Performance mods** handle the better FPS, less memory usage, faster loading and smoother chunk rendering.

**QoL mods** add the small things everyone always ends up installing anyway. Recipe viewer, zoom, inventory tweaks and food stats.

That's it. That's the whole pack. **Essentially essential.**

---

**All versions include:**
- AppleSkin
- Cloth Config
- Clumps
- Dynamic FPS
- EntityCulling
- FerriteCore
- ImmediatelyFast
- Jade
- Just Enough Items
- Lithium
- ModernFix
- More Culling
- Mouse Tweaks
- Sodium

**Fabric only:**
- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- Mod Menu
- Placeholder API
- YetAnotherConfigLib
- Zoomify

**NeoForge only:**
- Just Zoom
- Konkrete
